### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_space` | Read an app-created meeting space, for example name="spaces/space-fixture". | yes | no | auto |
| `create_space` | Create a meeting space with vendor defaults. Pass an empty body object. | no | no | ask |
| `end_conference` | End the active conference in spaces/space-fixture. This disrupts participants and requires approval. | no | yes | deny |
| `list_conferences` | List conference records for app-created spaces, using pageSize and pageToken. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_conference` | Read a conference record, for example conferenceRecords/conf-fixture. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_participants` | List participants of conferenceRecords/conf-fixture with a bounded pageSize. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_participant` | Read a participant by its full conferenceRecords/conf-fixture/participants/person-fixture resource name. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_recordings` | List recording metadata for conferenceRecords/conf-fixture; this does not download recording files. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_transcripts` | List transcript resources for conferenceRecords/conf-fixture; use list\_transcript\_entries to read text. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_transcript_entries` | Read transcript text entries for a full conferenceRecords/conf-fixture/transcripts/transcript-fixture resource name. | yes | no | auto |
